# From Backyard Adventures to Triangle Attractions: Recreation and Entertainment Near Fuquay-Varina


Tri Pointe Homes


•


October 21, 2026


Share this article


Fuquay-Varina’s[growing popularity](https://www.newsobserver.com/news/business/real-estate-news/article298453658.html) isn’t just about new places to shop and grab a bite. Beyond its expanding retail and dining scene, this Wake County town offers plenty of ways to get outside, stay active and enjoy your free time. From scenic greenways and community parks to sports facilities and local events, there are endless opportunities to make the most of life close to home.


When the mood strikes for a day trip or a change of scenery, residents of[Altis™ at Serenity by Tri Pointe Homes®](https://www.tripointehomes.com/nc/raleigh/altis-at-serenity) have their own town and the greater Triangle at their doorstep offering adventure!


**Take the Scenic Route**


Sometimes, the best way to spend a day is to get outside and see where the path leads. Fuquay-Varina makes that easy for its residents with its network of parks and trails.


The town’s[11 trails and greenways](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/1561/Trails-and-Greenways) , including 2 miles of trails at[South Lakes Greenway](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/facilities/facility/details/southlakesgreenway-22) and 143 acres of open green space at[Hilltop Needmore Town Park](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/facilities/facility/details/Hilltop-Needmore-Town-Park-Preserve-43) make enjoying the fresh air easy.


One local park,[Fuquay Mineral Spring Park](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/facilities/facility/details/Fuquay-Mineral-Spring-Park-11) , is a historic site that helped give the town its name. This mineral spring was discovered in 1858 and drew visitors from near and far to experience its “healing waters”. Today, visitors can visit the restored Springhouse, memorial brick path, picnic tables and footbridge all while walking through a piece of Fuquay-Varina’s history.


For those who are looking for a bigger adventure,[Raven Rock State Park](https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/raven-rock-state-park) is less than 30 miles from Altis at Serenity. The park offers trails for recreational activities like hiking, biking, camping, horseback riding, paddling and fishing. This state park is a North Carolina treasure offering hours of adventure and fun.


**Different Ways to Play**


Golf lovers will be pleased to know that Altis at Serenity is less than 10 miles from three area golf courses:[Bentwinds Golf & Country Club](https://www.bentwinds.org/) in Fuquay-Varina along with[Devils Ridge Golf Club](https://www.invitedclubs.com/clubs/devils-ridge-golf-club) and[12 Oaks Country Club](https://www.theclubat12oaks.com/web/pages/golf) in Holly Springs. For those looking to experience one of North Carolina’s most renowned golf destinations,[Pinehurst](https://www.pinehurst.com/) is only about an hour and twenty-minute car ride away, offering access to legendary courses and a rich history of the sport.


Pickleball enthusiasts can explore Fuquay-Varina’s[pickleball facilities](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/1761/Pickleball) , which includes indoor and outdoor options. The town also offers organized pickleball programs throughout the year for different ages and skill levels. Monthly, annual and drop-in fees are much lower for Fuquay-Varina residents!


**Catch a Game, See a Show, Explore the Arts**


For sports fans, Fuquay-Varina is close at hand to your favorite teams. Less than nine miles away from Altis at Serenity, the[Holly Springs Salamanders](https://salamandersbaseball.com/) are pitching up fun from May to August. Only a bit further, fans can catch their favorite Raleigh teams like the Carolina Hurricanes and North Carolina State University’s Wolfpack playing at the[Lenovo Center](https://www.lenovocenter.com/) or on campus, each about 20 miles from Altis at Serenity. Thirty miles away in Durham, Duke University’s 27 athletic teams are competing year-round, and the[Durham Bulls](https://www.mlb.com/milb/durham) are a summer staple for Triangle residents. No matter the time of year, there’s always a game to catch and a local team to cheer on.


The fun doesn’t stop when the final whistle blows. For music lovers, Altis at Serentiy puts live music across the Triangle within easy reach, including[Koka Booth Amphitheatre](https://www.boothamphitheatre.com/) in Cary, just 13 miles away, and[Red Hat Amphitheater](https://www.redhatamphitheater.com/) in Raleigh, 19 miles away. When bigger-name artists come to town, the Lenovo Center offers another nearby spot to catch a show.


For those looking to explore the arts and learn something new, the[Fuquay-Varina Arts Center](https://www.fuquay-varina.org/1754/Arts-Center) and other local museums offer plenty to discover only three miles from home. Just north in Raleigh, residents can explore attractions like the[North Carolina Museum of Natural Sciences](https://www.naturalsciences.org/) ,[North Carolina Museum of History](https://www.ncmuseumofhistory.org/) ,[North Carolina Museum of Art](https://ncartmuseum.org/plan-your-visit/?campaign=21477162230&content=706033185781&keyword=north%20carolina%20museum%20of%20art) and[Marbles Kids Museum](https://marbleskidsmuseum.org/) , making it easy to turn an ordinary day into an opportunity to learn something new.


**A Place to Enjoy More of Every Day**


From peaceful greenways and recreational facilities to local gathering spots and entertainment, Fuquay-Varina provides ways to make the most of your free time. Its growing selection of activities adds to the appeal of a town that continues to develop while holding on to its welcoming character. But it doesn’t stop at the town limits. With Raleigh and the greater Triangle within easy reach, residents can enjoy more when they want to venture further, although everything they need meets them where they already are.

From the luxury amenities this community offers to the convenience and character of Fuquay-Varina, it’s a place to relax and enjoy the day without ever having to go far, all in one little slice of the Triangle!
